posts.title: PostgreSQL logical replication with partitioned tables
posts.description: This post explains how publish_via_partition_root changes the logical replication behavior of partitioned tables in PostgreSQL. When a row is inserted into a partitioned table, it is stored in one of its leaf partitions.
